description: The Logic Neo X1 Pro comes with 8GB of RAM and 128GB of internal storage, which can be expanded up to 1TB. Its camera setup includes a 13-megapixel rear sensor and an 8-megapixel front camera. The tablet supports dual-band Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.3, GPS, and 4G LTE connectivity. The standard education edition also has an IP52 rating for dust and splash resistance. Logic has yet to disclose pricing or retail availability.
title: Logic Neo X1 Pro Tablet Launched in India With Android 17, 8,000mAh Battery

description: Airtel has announced Airtel Travel Week 2026 in India, offering customers discounts and travel-related benefits. As part of the campaign, 1,000 prepaid and 1,000 postpaid customers will get a 10 percent discount on international roaming packs.  Airtel Travel Week will be available through the Airtel app from November 19 to November 25, 2026.
title: Airtel Travel Week 2026: 10% Off International Roaming, Up to Rs. 4,000 Off Visas

description: Xiaomi has raised the prices of one Xiaomi tablet and two Redmi tablets. The company has updated its online store in India to reflect the revised pricing. The Xiaomi Pad 8 now starts at Rs. 39,999 for the base 8GB + 128GB variant, while the top-of-the-line 12GB + 256GB model costs Rs. 47,999. This marks a Rs. 1,000 price hike for both models, up from Rs. 38,999 and Rs. 46,999, respectively. Meanwhile, the Redmi Pad 2 Pro is now available on the Xiaomi India online store, starting at Rs. 29,999 for the Wi-Fi-only 8GB + 128GB option. However, the Wi-Fi-only 8GB + 128GB RAM and storage configuration of the Redmi Pad 2 has seen the biggest price jump, rising Rs. 2,000 to Rs. 23,999 from Rs. 21,999.
title: Xiaomi Pad 8, Redmi Pad 2 Series Get Up to Rs. 2,000 Price Hike

description: OnePlus 17 will be launched next year with multiple upgrades in the display department, according to a tipster. The leaker claims that the handset will be equipped with a new 6.89-inch display with 2K resolution. It might also ship with the next-generation LIPO panel from BOE. Further, the OnePlus 17 will reportedly sport “ultra-narrow” bezels on all four sides of the touchscreen. The smartphone might also offer BT.2020 colour gamut and a custom display chip. On top of this, the display of the next-generation OnePlus flagship is said to deliver up to a 240Hz refresh rate. However, the tech firm has yet to confirm these details.
title: 240Hz on a Phone? OnePlus 17 Leak Points to Massive 2K Display Upgrade Over OnePlus 16

description: A user reports that the Motorola Razr Fold has started receiving the Android 17 update in select global markets. The user shared a screenshot showing firmware A171WB.27-36-2 and a download size of 4.15GB. While the company has not yet officially announced the rollout, a wider Android 17 release is expected soon. According to the Motorola support page, the Android 17 update brings stackable widgets to smartphones. Users can also match app icon themes to the system theme. The Android 17 update also lets users hide labels on settings tiles by selecting the Classic style. At launch, the company announced that the foldable will receive up to seven Android OS upgrades and up to seven years of security updates.
title: Motorola Razr Fold Finally Gets Android 17 Update With Stackable Widgets

description: Payward, the parent company of cryptocurrency exchange Kraken, has agreed to acquire Tribe Capital, a venture capital and asset management firm. The firm manages $2.7 billion in assets and has investments in companies including SpaceX, OpenAI, and Shiprocket. Payward plans to combine Tribe’s investment expertise with its existing financial services, including custody, trading and tokenisation.
title: Kraken Parent Payward to Acquire OpenAI and SpaceX Backer Tribe Capital

description: Cybersecurity firm Blockaid has identified more than 8,800 suspicious GTA-themed tokens on Solana ahead of the game’s release. Scammers have also created fake gaming storefronts, airdrop campaigns, and cryptocurrency presales to target interested players. One fraudulent website impersonated the PlayStation Store and prompted visitors to connect their crypto wallets instead of completing a normal purchase.
title: Buying GTA 6? Beware of 8,800+ Fake Solana Tokens and Wallet-Draining Scam Sites

description: Samsung's upcoming Galaxy Buds Active could feature an ear-hook design, two types of ear tips and customisable touch controls. References in the One UI 9.5 beta also point to ANC, adjustable ambient sound, UHQ audio playback and Auracast support. The earbuds may lack wear detection, head gestures and head tracking for 360 Audio, however. Other expected features include Auto Switch, Find My Earbuds and integration with Samsung's Modes and Routines. Samsung has not confirmed the earbuds or their launch plans.
title: Samsung Galaxy Buds Active Leak Hints at Design, ANC Support and Other Key Features

description: Samsung is rumoured to be entering the premium over-ear headphone segment with a new product called Galaxy Studio. In recent weeks, the rumour mill has hinted at its design and colour options. A new report now reveals some of its key specifications. The headphones will reportedly feature active noise cancellation (ANC), spatial audio with head tracking, wear detection, and both wireless and wired connectivity options. The Galaxy Studio could pack an 870mAh battery.
title: Samsung Galaxy Studio Features Surface in One UI 9.5 Beta Code; May Support Spatial Audio, Wired Connectivity

description: OpenAI has launched the ChatGPT for Accounting plugin, the company announced on Thursday. The plugin aims to guide users on recurring accounting work, the company said. The new tool can help users prepare month-end reports, reconcile bank accounts, enter data, and maintain accounting books. ChatGPT for Accounting also claims to help users prepare for financial audits. ChatGPT for Accounting can work with multiple accounting tools, including BILL, Campfire, FreshBooks, Oracle NetSuite, Oracle QuickStart, QuickBooks Online, Rillet, and Xero. Users can download the available plugins for them to connect them to their ChatGPT account. Separately, the company also announced it has begun rolling out a new Live Dictation update for ChatGPT. The AI giant claims that the update improves the speed and reliability of the speech-to-text tool.
title: OpenAI Releases Improved Live Dictation in ChatGPT; Releases Specialised Accounting Tool for AI Chatbot

description: Vi Business has expanded its enterprise communication services with a WhatsApp-based offering for companies of different sizes. The service gives MSMEs access to online registration, bulk messaging, interactive templates and engagement analytics. Larger organisations can use AI-powered chatbots and connect WhatsApp messaging and voice with Vi Business' CPaaS and CCaaS platforms. The launch follows the operator's recent introduction of four voice-only prepaid recharges, which offer unlimited calls and SMS without mobile data and comply with TRAI's requirement for standalone voice and SMS plans.
title: Vi Business Adds WhatsApp Solutions for MSMEs With Under 15-Minute Onboarding

description: Instagram’s latest update lets users edit Stories. The editing feature covers text, music, stickers and drawings, while preserving the post's existing views, likes and replies. Meta-owned instant platform has also launched new stickers. It has also changed the way users select multiple photos and added new background options.
title: Edit Instagram Stories After Posting: New Feature Gives Users a 15-Minute Window

description: Motorola has been rumoured to expand its foldable lineup with a new book-style foldable. The purported handset, dubbed the Motorola Razr Flex 2027, has been the subject of several leaks recently. A new report now suggests that the unannounced foldable could use a yet-to-be-announced flagship-class Snapdragon processor. Separately, an alleged rear image has also surfaced on a social media site, which offers an early look at the Razr Flex 2027’s form factor.
title: Motorola Razr Flex 2027 to Reportedly Feature Unannounced Flagship Snapdragon Chip; Design Leaks

description: Google has updated its flagship AI Ultra subscription to include a YouTube Premium Family plan. With this move, the Mountain View-based tech giant expands one of the benefits previously available to subscribers. Rather than being limited to an individual subscription, the upgrade lets users share ad-free video streaming and music playback with up to five other family members in their household. Google says the change applies to both Google AI Ultra 5x and AI Ultra 20x plans.
title: Google AI Ultra Gets a Major Perk: YouTube Premium Family for 5 Members

description: Crypto exchange Bitrue has introduced USDT-settled perpetual futures for DacityCoin, a memecoin inspired by Grand Theft Auto VI. The DACITYCOIN/USDT contract offers up to 10x leverage, allowing traders to speculate on price movements without owning the underlying token. The listing comes ahead of the anticipated GTA 6 release, but questions remain about which Solana token the exchange’s contract is linked to.
title: GTA 6-Inspired Meme Coin DacityCoin Lists on Bitrue Futures With 10x Leverage

description: OnePlus has started rolling out the stable ColorOS 17 update for the Nord 6 and Nord CE 6 smartphones in India. The latest software release brings system-level AI features and other updates. ColorOS 17 update for the OnePlus Nord 6 carries the firmware version CPH2793_17.0.0.100(EX01). The OnePlus Nord CE 6 is receiving version CPH2805_17.0.0.101(EX01).
title: OnePlus Nord 6, Nord CE 6 Get ColorOS 17 Stable Update in India

description: Apple announced the finalists for its 2026 App Store Awards on Wednesday. The Cupertino-based tech giant is recognising the developers behind some of the year's notable apps and games across its device portfolio and services. This year's shortlist includes 45 developers competing across various categories covering the iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV, Apple Vision Pro, and Apple Arcade. Apple will announce the winners in the coming weeks.
title: Apple Reveals 45 Best Apps and Games of 2026: Crimson Desert, Adobe Premiere Make the Cut

description: Vivo X500 Pro Max, Vivo X500 Pro, and Vivo X500 prices in India and RAM and storage configurations have leaked online. The leaker has highlighted that the standard and the Pro models will not be offered in a 512GB storage option “for now”, hinting at a later debut. We already know that the Vivo X500 series and Vivo Watch GT 2 will be launched in India on September 26. The smartphones and the smartwatch will be available for purchase in the country via the Vivo online store, Amazon, and Flipkart. The company recently announced that the Vivo X500 Pro and Vivo X500 Pro Max will be offered in Apex Orange and Eternal Black colour options. Meanwhile, the standard model will be available for purchase in Ember Red and Titanium Black colourways.
title: Vivo X500 Series, Watch GT 2 India Prices and Storage Variants Leak Ahead of Launch

description: Google's Gemini 4 Neon supports a context window of up to one million tokens and can process text, images, audio and video. The model is designed to support multi-step workflows, including debugging code, analysing data, and preparing reports. It also supports four thinking levels and can coordinate smaller AI agents to complete complex tasks. Google claims Neon costs 32 percent less per task than Gemini 4 Carbon at the default High setting. It is available through Google's developer and AI platforms.
title: Google Unveils Gemini 4 Neon With Four Thinking Levels, Cybersecurity Features

description: After years of anticipation, Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here. But before players can explore Vice City and the wider state of Leonida, they will need to make room for Rockstar Games' latest title on their latest-generation consoles. The Take-Two-owned company has confirmed that GTA 6 requires a massive amount of storage space on both the PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. It is one of the larger game installations on current-generation consoles, particularly for owners of entry-level models with less built-in storage.
title: GTA 6 Download Size on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S: How Much Space Do You Need?

description: Apple will introduce Siri AI usage limits with the iOS 27.3 update, according to an iOS developer. The new limits were spotted in the iOS 27.3 beta. He has also shared screenshots of the alert. After a user hits the Siri AI usage limit, Apple shows them a prompt to upgrade their iCloud+ plan. The iOS developer added that he currently pays for the $9.99 iCloud+ plan. The Siri AI usage-limit notification appeared when the user asked Apple’s AI agent to turn off his “Lounge TV”. However, Siri AI did complete the assigned task. Moreover, the iOS developer noted that Apple's AI chatbot continued to answer simple questions. Meanwhile, it stopped generating responses to more complex prompts, like “Compare height to the Statue of Liberty and the Burj Khalifa, how much does it cost to make[?]”. The developer also said that he hit the daily Siri AI usage limit after 40 requests “in the whole day”.
title: Pay for Siri? iOS 27.3 Could Cap AI Usage Unless You Upgrade to iCloud+

description: Nothing is gearing up to introduce its first AI-native device next month. In recent days, the company has teased the design of the upcoming product, which is confirmed to feature a metal case with pill-shaped LEDs, encased in a textured body. Ahead of its debut, a tipster has leaked the first image of Nothing's upcoming AI device, which offers a clearer look at the hardware. It appears to be a compact, button-led device with a slim rectangular body, a dedicated control labelled Talk, and red and green indicator lights.
title: Nothing's First AI-Native Device Leaked With Physical Talk Button, Red and Green LED Lights

description: Sony has launched the WH-CH730N and WH-CH530 wireless headphones in India. They offer Bluetooth connectivity and support Sony's Digital Sound Enhancement Engine (DSEE) technology. The Sony WH-CH730N offers active noise cancellation (ANC).  The Sony WH-CH730N is priced at Rs. 12,990 in India, while the Sony WH-CH530 is priced at Rs. 4,490.
title: Sony WH-CH730N, WH-CH530 Wireless Headphones Launched in India: Price, Specifications

description: Apple is rumoured to be developing a special handset to commemorate the iPhone's 20th anniversary. While the Cupertino-based tech giant has yet to reveal any details, leaks suggest it could launch next year. According to a tipster’s recent claims, Apple is testing multiple design versions, with different approaches to the front glass, which is expected to curve around all four edges. The company has reportedly spent years refining the curvature, which remains a work in progress.
title: Apple’s 20th Anniversary iPhone Leak: Quad-Curved Glass and a Titanium Comeback

description: Vivo is reportedly developing its next-generation book-style foldable smartphone, possibly called Vivo X Fold 7. A new leak claims that the company is evaluating flagship chipsets from Qualcomm and MediaTek for the upcoming handset. It is said to be considering two chipsets manufactured using a 2nm process. The final selection may depend on their pricing.
title: Vivo X Fold 7 Said to Be in Development With 2nm Snapdragon, MediaTek Chip Options

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is now out on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X. Before you dive into the game, you need to make sure your console is ready for it. From ensuring you have the required storage space to updating the system software, here are 10 things you should do to keep your PS5 or Xbox Series S/X console ready for GTA 6.
title: Is Your Console Ready for Grand Theft Auto 6? 10 Things to Check Before Playing

description: Samsung is reportedly exploring an extremely bezel-less display for its upcoming Galaxy flagship smartphones, according to a tipster on the South Korean platform Naver. The company could introduce the technology before Apple's rumoured 20th anniversary iPhone in 2027. The display is reportedly progressing well, although some issues with other phone components remain. Samsung may use a flat panel with narrow borders or a curved design. The Galaxy S27 series could be among the first to feature the technology.
title: Samsung Could Beat Apple to the First Truly Bezel-Less Phone Display

description: Bitcoin and Ethereum remained under pressure as investors assessed the Federal Reserve’s hawkish signals and the possibility of another interest rate hike in December. WazirX reported extreme fear across the market, while data highlighted continued institutional withdrawals and the distribution of long-term Bitcoin holders. Analysts advised caution, recommending staggered purchases and waiting for stronger price momentum before increasing exposure.
title: Bitcoin Price Drops to Roughly Rs. 59.1 Lakh, Ethereum at Rs. 1.67 Lakh Amid US Fed Fears

description: GTA 6 is offered in two editions, namely Standard and Ultimate. The Standard Edition of GTA 6 offers the main story missions. As a limited-time bonus, Rockstar Games is also offering the additional Vintage Vice City Pack, which features the two-tone 1955 Vapid Stanier sedan, along with a garage on Ocean Beach. The pack also offers special outfits and hairstyles for both characters, namely Jason and Lucia. It also includes an “iconic” weapon pattern. Apart from this, the Standard Edition also offers one montg subscription to GTA+ for a month at no additional cost as limited-time bonus. Rockstar Games’ GTA 6 Ultimate Edition brings much more in addition to the limited-time bonuses offered with the Standard Edition. You get access to the 1995 Grotti Cheetah sports car, Hawk and Little Morgan revolvers for Jason and Lucia, personalised sidearms for the characters, exclusive Vice City Style outfits and tattoos. Further, it offers the Dinka Enduro motorcycle in the army livery, and Crest Ka
title: GTA 6 Price in India: Standard vs Ultimate Edition and Where to Buy

description: Google Photos is said to be working on a new feature that uses AI to suggest outfits from a user's digital wardrobe. The upcoming  ‘Build a fit’ option has reportedly been spotted in the latest version of the Google Photos app for Android. It could appear within the existing Wardrobe section. The app could also retain the existing manual selection functionality.
title: Google Photos Could Get New ‘Build a Fit' Feature to Suggest Outfits, APK Teardown Reveals

description: Caviar's Most Wanted collection brings GTA-inspired designs to several high-end devices, with customised versions of the iPhone 18 Pro series, iPhone Duo and Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra. The range also includes two editions of the Ray-Ban Wayfarer Gen 2 smart glasses. Prices start at $6,700 (roughly Rs. 6.26 lakh) for the Gold Rush glasses and go up to $13,130 (roughly Rs. 12.27 lakh) for the iPhone Duo Pink Alligator. Orders are being accepted through Caviar's website.
title: Caviar Launches GTA 6-Inspired iPhone, Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra and Ray-Ban Smart Glasses

description: Apple could introduce the standard iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2 in March 2027, according to a new report from South Korea. The company's reported supply chain preparations suggest that both smartphones are moving towards an early-year launch. Samsung and LG will reportedly supply display panels for the iPhone 18. Samsung Display is said to be the sole panel supplier for the iPhone Air 2.
title: iPhone 18, iPhone Air 2 Launch Timeline Tipped; Display Production Plans Surface
